channels.features: R freckle dots, G lips mask, B liner wing (player option), A upper/lower lash line + liner
channels.features2: R stubble (male only), G blush zones, B scalp/hairline, A face (1) vs neck painted to continue the body tone (0): the shader lights A=0 with the body parameters
channels.eye: RGB sclera + neutral iris detail, A iris tint mask (pupil excluded)
channels.brows: RGBA = brow styles arched, straight, soft, angled (hair-stroke masks; the runtime picks one and shapes thickness)

shader_notes: skin = skin_color * mix(value, detail, k) with detail = albedo_lin / skin_reference_lin and value = luminance ratio (same formula as face_appearance.gdshader; k ~0.55 on the face). Apply freckles (darker warm tone x amount), stubble (towards darkened skin + hair colour), lips (lip tint scaled by skin luminance), liner (near-black brown), brows (brow colour, default hair colour x0.75) in that order.
